merger.contracts: MetaDEX 1.0.0 deployed on Arc (2026-09-15); 1.0.1 (2026-10-02) lists no deployment; Base addresses not published at 2026-10-10
merger.conversion: AERO 1:1; VELO about 0.044 AERO (94.5% / 5.5% split); veNFT -> sAERO stake via the upgrade portal (not automatic); remaining lock rounded up to whole weeks, capped at 4 years; permanent locks stay permanent (Migration._resolveStake, github.com/Dromos-Labs/metadex-public); expired locks settle liquid
merger.new_system: continuous allocation instead of epochs; stakers receive 100% of exchange revenue of the pools they support plus incentives (IncentiveClaim in IVoter); an allocation cooldown (47 h at launch, per press); sAERO is a transferable NFT; MAXTIME 4 years with linear decay or permanent mode
merger.start_utc: 2026-10-22 00:00 (MERGER_TS); legacy emissions and weekly voting end
merger.what: Aerodrome and Velodrome merge into Aero (Dromos Labs MetaDEX); one token, AERO
